rubrics.title: Lab 12 — Gun Violence Dashboards in Tableau Public and Gemini Canvas

criteria.description: Student-owned Tableau Public profile URL; a separate six-field GVA Data Source named firstname_lastname_lab12_data, validated types/rows/dates, GVA source, and source accessible through that profile.

Published firstname_lastname_lab12 Workbook: four views, shared Choose Measure CASE calculation, dynamic titles, correct counts, state filtering, locality drill-down, highlighter, source link, waterfall and reset.

Publicly shared Gemini Canvas app with the same CSV and four views, three selectable measures, state filters and Reset, one verified design improvement, and default data accessible to a separate viewer.

One Canvas text entry with exactly two URLs (student Tableau Public Profile and public Gemini Canvas app) plus 4–6 sentences, two numeric checks, interaction comparison, AI design improvement and incident-date range.
